questions.questionText: hour 15 minutes Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any working should be done in this booklet. Electronic calculators may be used. questions.questionText: Two isolated spheres have masses 2.0kg and 4.0kg. The spheres collide and then move apart. During the collision, the 2.0kg mass has an average acceleration of 8.0ms–2. What is the average acceleration of the 4.0kg mass?

questions.questionText: Which statement about energy is not correct?

options.A: Energy is never lost but it may be transferred between different forms.
options.B: In an inelastic collision, the total energy is constant.
options.C: The efficiency of a system is the ratio of the useful energy output to the total energy input.
options.D: When a machine does work, friction reduces the total energy.
